source.title: Spirit Crossing
source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 7Alcohol and Tobacco Reference, Comic Mischief, Mild Fantasy Violence, Mild LanguageUsers Interact, In-Game PurchasesGamesSpirit CrossingReleases 11/16/26VersionNintendo Switch 2EditionDigitalSale ends: 11/21/26 at 07:59 a.m. UTCAlcohol and Tobacco Reference, Comic Mischief, Mild Fantasy Violence, Mild LanguageUsers Interact, In-Game PurchasesLoadingWelcome to your strange new home.Glide through pastel clouds, heal troubled spirits along the way, and design your own home nestled high on a mountain peak. Befriend strangers around a warm campfire, or share memories while lazily fishing in the sky with a friend.In Spirit Crossing, you can play together or by yourself, for as long as you like. Each stranger you befriend blooms into color, revealing the unique person behind their gray shadow. Make a friend, or just quietly share the same little corner of the world. Our game is built around small acts of kindness, and the way even brief connections can make us feel a little less alone.Show off your style with hundreds of hairstyles, dyes, head coverings, prosthetics, and mix-and-match outfits, then bring it all to life with dozens of expressive emotes. Come as you are, or try on someone new! Then design the ultimate space to host your friends, from cozy cottage to full-blown castle. Fill it with enough furniture, plants, rugs, lamps, and tiny trinkets to ensure no shelf goes tragically undecorated.From Spry Fox:Spirit Crossing has been in development for over five years. At the heart of this project is our belief that games should bring people together, encourage kindness, and reduce loneliness in this chaotic world we live in.Software description provided by the publisher.Publisher notification(s):This product can only be played on Nintendo Switch™ 2. A separate product, "Spirit Crossing", is available for Nintendo Switch™.Save data and Additional Contents are not compatible between the two versions. source.title: Next Week on XBOX: New Games for November 9 to 13
source.evidenceText: Will Fulton, XBOX Wire Editor November 6, 2026 · 13 min read Welcome to Next Week on XBOX! In this weekly feature we cover all the games coming soon to XBOX Series X|S, XBOX One, XBOX on PC, and Game Pass! Get more details on these upcoming games below and click their profiles for further info (release dates subject to change). Let’s jump in! Football Manager 27 SEGA ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now PC Game Pass Football Manager 27 – November 10Game Pass Choose the club. Shape the squad. Set the tactics. Chase the future only you can see. FM27 is where your footballing beliefs become a reality. Make The Call. Pick the team. Define your style. Spot what other managers might miss. Maybe you take a chance on the academy prospect. Maybe you sell the star who just doesn’t get your vision. Train your team to work as one. Build a tactical blueprint that’s unmistakably yours. Then lead your team out to admiration from the stands as you take your place on the touchline. Football Manager 27 Console SEGA ☆☆☆☆☆ 24 ★★★★★ $59.99 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass Football Manager 27 Console – November 10Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Choose the club. Shape the squad. Set the tactics. Chase the future only you can see. FM27 Console is where your footballing beliefs become a reality. Make The Call. Immerse yourself in the managerial journey with refined layouts that give you a clearer view of what matters most to sharpen your approach. Smarter navigation makes use of every inch of space, while fully customisable Controller Mapping puts more power in your hands, so you can tailor your setup to your gameplan. TANUKI: Pon's Summer CRITICAL REFLEX ☆☆☆☆☆ 27 ★★★★★ $19.99 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass TANUKI: Pon’s Summer – November 10Game Pass / Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere Hop on your BMX and deliver letters and packages to the quirky inhabitants of TANUKI’s fictional Japanese island. Packages vary in size, weight, and shape so it’ll be up to you to strategise how you approach each delivery. As you build up friendship and loyalty with the inhabitants, they’ll ask for help with a range of different activities. Take part to unlock items and rewards that will help with the shrine’s restoration. Warhammer Survivors Auroch Digital ☆☆☆☆☆ 167 ★★★★★ $7.99 $7.19 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass Warhammer Survivors – November 10Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Warhammer Survivors is a fast-paced roguelite survivors’ game, pitting a host of iconic Warhammer characters against endless hordes of enemies from multiple Warhammer factions. Developed by Auroch Digital (Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun) in partnership with Warhammer and poncle (Vampire Survivors), discover the universes of Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer: Age of Sigmar in all its pixel glory in this new surviv-a-ton. Hope in the City Lofty Sky Games and NAGA Games ☆☆☆☆☆ 3 ★★★★★ $19.99 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass Hope in the City – November 11Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Your sketches may be the only clues you have. Play as 17-year-old Hope Song in this narrative mystery set in Shenyang, China. While everyone around her cracks under exam pressure, Hope escapes into her drawings, until her parents disappear. Investigate what happened, connect the clues, and uncover the truth hidden beneath the city’s calm. 9 Kings (Game Preview) Hooded Horse ☆☆☆☆☆ 6 ★★★★★ Get it now PC Game Pass 9 Kings (Game Preview) – November 12Game Pass Build your city into the most powerful of all kingdoms through endless combinations of buildings, units, spells, and positioning. Take advantage of chaotic combos and powerful perks to break the game and become overpowered. Grow your kingdom in strategic ways, prepare for dozens of unique events, and show the world your kingdom can outlast all others in both single and async multiplayer. This game is a work in progress. It may or may not change over time or release as a final product. Purchase only if you are comfortable with the current state of the unfinished game. Hozy tinyBuild ☆☆☆☆☆ 4 ★★★★★ $14.99 $11.99 Get it now Hozy – November 9XBOX Play Anywhere Wrap yourself in a cozy atmosphere where every small action and detail matters. Hozy is about slowing down. There are no timers, scores, penalties, and absolutely no stress or pressure. Just you, your tools, and the simple joy of making spaces beautiful again. Whether you’re wiping windows, repainting walls, or finding the perfect spot for a sofa, everything is designed to keep you in a calm, satisfying flow. Captain Coco: Treasure Island (Xbox Series) Afil Games ☆☆☆☆☆ 1 ★★★★★ $4.99 $3.99 Get it now Captain Coco: Treasure Island – November 10 Set sail for a tropical puzzle adventure in Captain Coco: Treasure Island! Join Captain Coco, a clever pirate monkey on a mission to crack open treasure chests by pushing coconuts across mysterious island levels. But don’t be fooled by the sunny beaches and lush jungles! Every stage is a brain-teasing challenge that requires careful planning, clever moves, and a little pirate ingenuity. Hard West 2 Klabater ☆☆☆☆☆ 2 ★★★★★ $34.99 Get it now Hard West 2 – November 10 Hard West 2 is a journey to the heart of darkness in the American West. Take control of a supernatural posse and catch the mysterious Ghost Train. Outsmart, outcheat and outgun your enemies in this turn-based tactics game set in a Wild West world where nothing is as it seems. Ova Magica Top Hat Studios, Inc. ☆☆☆☆☆ 1 ★★★★★ $29.99 $23.99 Get it now Ova Magica – November 10Smart Delivery Start a new life on an overgrown farm in the rural and peaceful Clover Town. You’re not alone this time—raise adorable blob companions that help you farm, explore, and make new friends. Ova Magica blends farm-life simulation with creature-collecting JRPG gameplay for a cozy yet adventurous experience.
